title: High-Density DSH-Style Context Compactor with LLM condensation, model inheritance, and paper accordion UI
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer & react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Implemented lossless semantic context condensation into 7 structured Markdown sections (Primary Request, Key Concepts, Files & Code, Errors & Fixes, Pending Jobs, Current Work, Critical Invariants). Added compactor model selector in Settings with 'inherit' default. Rendered tactile white paper accordion card for compacted history in Drawer stream.
